title: Production Recovery durable evidence authority adapters

phases.objective: Provide immutable partial-mutation receipt persistence and canonical durable Production role-selection proof resolution without enabling Production live execution.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Partial mutation receipts are content-bound and immutable through the existing Recovery Control Store idempotency invariant, role selection is resolved only from canonical durable full-inspection evidence, and the remaining execution/readback/ledger authorities stay explicit blockers.
steps: Construct adapters over an isolated Recovery Control Store without opening a database connection.
Normalize and validate the canonical Hostinger partial-rebuild receipt.
Persist it as a Recovery run whose idempotency key is receipt_id and whose run identity is derived from the canonical receipt hash.
Read back the exact content binding before returning persisted=true.
Resolve Production selected-role proof using only exact SHA, target key, operation, action, and durable inspection-run reference.
Discard caller-selected roles, fingerprints, finding IDs, and other authority-bearing proof claims.
Return the four still-deferred execution/readback/ledger components explicitly and keep production_live disabled.
assertions: The same receipt_id cannot be rebound to different receipt content.
Caller-provided selected roles or proof hashes never become proof authority.
The canonical resolved proof remains source=durable_full_inspection and is exact-SHA/target bound.
Construction performs no database connection, provider access, workflow dispatch, deployment, migration, grant, or Production mutation.
Governance Migration Ledger is not emulated by Recovery Control Store.

phases.objective: Add and certify the host-local mutation executor, independent role-aware readback verifier, and separate Governance Migration Ledger adapter while keeping Production mutation disabled.
Keep Production live Recovery blocked until the complete deployment-owned graph, fresh signed certification, exact Production deployment attestation, and separate activation authorization exist.
